root_cause.text: The bounds check used an incorrect comparison operator (`<=` instead of `<`) when validating the `eng_id` index against the `stream_enc_regs` array size, allowing out-of-bounds access when `eng_id` equals 5 (ENGINE_ID_DIGF) or is negative.
root_cause.evidence: The original code checked `if (eng_id <= ENGINE_ID_DIGF)` where `ENGINE_ID_DIGF` is 5 and `stream_enc_regs[]` has only 5 entries (indices 0-4). This allowed `eng_id=5` to pass the check and be used as an array index at line 1284 (`&stream_enc_regs[eng_id]`), accessing one element past the array bounds. The patch replaces this with `if (eng_id < 0 || eng_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(stream_enc_regs))` to properly reject both negative values and values at or beyond the array size.
